Residual concern logged as FIND-R4-001 (do_improve is in stdout only, not strategy.json; LLM parsing is not mechanical).
round1FixVerification.FIND-002_strategy_json_corruption: VERIFIED FIXED. passprep.py:83-84 catches json.JSONDecodeError/OSError/ValueError on corrupt file. evidence.description: do_improve computed AFTER atomic_write (line 120); do_improve is in stdout only, NOT in strategy.json. The spec invariant 'DETERMINISTIC-BOOKKEEPING' at line 248 claims this is fully deterministic, but the LLM parsing of stdout is non-mechanical.

B4 section (line 62) says 'Read ~/gig/lessons.jsonl (all rows)' but Pass structure (line 203) says 'tail -n 50 ~/gig/lessons.jsonl (last 50 lessons only)'. Two contradictory instructions in the same spec document.

Last-resort FALLBACK dict code path (triggered when strategy.default.json is also missing) has no test coverage. passprep.test.mjs always resolves SKILL_DIR to the real skill directory which has strategy.default.json, so shutil.copy2 path executes in all tests, never the FALLBACK dict.

Test 1 correctly creates an isolated temp HOME with no gig/ dir. SKILL_DIR resolves to real script location. shutil.copy2 finds the real strategy.default.json and succeeds. The FALLBACK dict at passprep.py:23-50 is never reached.
atomic_write: tempfile.mkstemp in same dir as target (same filesystem, no cross-device risk), os.replace (POSIX atomic), exception cleanup of tmp file on failure.
Skip-floor: `if priority and all(c in skip for c in priority): strategy['skip_categories'] = []` — correct superset check with empty-priority guard.
pass_count: `int(strategy.get('pass_count') or 0) + 1` — handles None/missing/falsy without crashing. do_improve: `pass_count % cadence == 0` — correct modulo gate.
Deterministic earnings read guards: SETTLED set + non-empty evidence + jnum(jpy)>0. jnum() catches non-numeric/None values with try/except. All three files consistent.
Crash-safe outer try/except in main(): emits valid JSON with safe defaults + do_improve=False + _error field. Never raises to caller.

Pure stdlib, no external deps. load_strategy/atomic_write/main separation is clean. Repair path is self-healing (partial shutil.copy2 detected as corrupt on next pass, repaired again). Functions are focused and <=30 lines each.

STARTUP contains all 9 required behavioral markers: STEP0/passprep, PRE-STEP every pass, NURTURE ALL, APPLY BROADLY, LEARN, EARNED CHECK, IMPROVE STEP, BOT-TO-BOT SHARE, FINALLY. No-fake-earn guard ('do NOT claim USDC / do NOT call record-earn') present.
FILES array: ['gig-cli.sh', 'monitor.sh', 'gig-healthcheck.sh', 'auditor.sh', 'run.sh'] — all 5 live loop files covered. FIND-R3-001 is fixed.

validateLessonRow() and isValidEarnRow() are test-local helpers. 12 tests using them validate the helpers' own logic, not the production cron instruction. The read-side guards in monitor/auditor/run partially mitigate at runtime.

6 tests exercise real passprep.py against temp HOME dirs. All 6 pass through the shutil.copy2 repair path (strategy.default.json present in SKILL_DIR). The FALLBACK dict code path (passprep.py:96-99) is not reached by any test.

Tests 4 and 5 (pass_count increment and do_improve true/false) correctly exercise the deterministic gate by setting pass_count in the temp HOME strategy.json and verifying output. These are genuine behavioral tests using the real script.
FIND-004 dedup fix verified: greps actual gig-cli.sh text for /shared-lessons\.jsonl/ and /requestId.*outcome/. Real assertion on production code.
